payload.description:
As a household member, I want queue retries to be invisible, so that one request never becomes two answers or two bills from concurrent model calls.

Feature: Duplicate turn delivery

Scenario: Two workers receive the same logical turn
  Given one unfinished turn job is delivered twice
  When two workers try to process it concurrently
  Then only one worker begins the model attempt
  And only that attempt can append progress or completion
  And the channel receives at most one final answer
payload.title: Duplicate delivery produces one model attempt
